why: the same as 010 with an exponent: -.33e1 has no integer part and is no JSON number, and it holds no forbidden character, so it is the string "-.33e1"; with a + in the exponent it is an error (011). typesafe/config releases up to 1.4.9 parse it as -3.3; upstream main since lightbend/config#861 (unreleased) reads the string
